title: 信息日报 2026-07-25

headline.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5，登顶多项 AI 评测排行榜
headline.summary: Anthropic 发布全新旗舰模型 Claude Opus 5，官方称其在智能水平上接近 Claude Fable 5，但价格仅为其一半。该模型在 Artificial Analysis 智能排行榜上跃居第一，并在长周期智能编程、多文件重构等任务上表现优异，同时是至今最抗提示注入的模型之一。
headline.summary_en: Anthropic released its new flagship model Claude Opus 5, described as approaching the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price. It quickly claimed the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard, excelling in long-horizon agentic coding and multi-file refactors, and is among the most prompt-injection-resistant models to date.
headline.reason: Claude Opus 5 发布是当日最具影响力的 AI 新闻，在开发者社区引起广泛关注，且直接关联 AI 大模型竞争格局。
headline.reason_en: The launch of Claude Opus 5 is the most impactful AI news of the day, generating widespread developer interest and directly affecting the competitive landscape of large language models.
